verdict.rationale: Attio's docs say lists can be used to model business processes, and the workspace supports custom objects and multiple lists with rich attribute types. Kanban views and stage-conversion reporting suggest stage-based pipelines, so separate lists per product or motion is a plausible way to run multiple pipelines. Nothing in the evidence explicitly says each list or pipeline can have its own distinct stage set, so this is inferred rather than documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multiple pipelines with independent stage definitions, per-pipeline stage configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
